evals.prompt: Can you review the order-validation change in evals/fixtures/validation-refactor/? Intent: the duplicated validation was extracted out of the request handler into a shared validator. Read the files and tell me what to tell the author.
evals.expected_output: A review in which every finding cites a file and line from the fixture files and carries a review axis plus one of the skill's severity labels, closing with an explicit verdict.
expectations: Every finding cites a file path and a line number from the fixture files; a finding with no such citation fails this
Every finding names a review axis and a severity label drawn from Critical, Required, Nit, Optional, or FYI; a finding missing either label fails this
The review ends with an explicit verdict of approve, request changes, or comment

evals.prompt: Can you review the change to how the queue parses its payload in evals/fixtures/order-service-false-positive/? Intent: the parser now raises on a malformed payload instead of returning an empty dict. Read the files and give me the review.
evals.expected_output: A review grounded in the fixture code rather than the request text — findings drawn from more than one module and one finding anchored to the test that documents the contract — closing with an explicit verdict.
expectations: Findings are grounded in code from at least two of the three source modules (parser.py, producer.py, queue.py); a review whose findings all cite a single file fails this
At least one finding cites tests/test_payload.py as evidence for what the payload contract already guarantees; a review that files findings without reference to the documenting test fails this
The review ends with an explicit verdict of approve, request changes, or comment
